title: ws-voice-state (app to server)

scope.description: run: the joined participants of the run; session: the owner and the viewers of the Session.

mic.description: on: open microphone; off: muted by the person; ptt: push-to-talk (sends only while the key is held).

description: The device changes its microphone state in the room it is in (else error forbidden). Every device in the room gets voice_room. Needs together_v1.
